verdict.rationale: Gmail documents Undo Send: you can retract a message right after sending, with a configurable cancellation window of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds. Nothing in the pack documents scheduling an email to send later. Snooze applies to received mail, the offline Outbox sends on reconnect, and Gemini's "Schedule" proposes meeting times, so none of these count as send-later. missing for 10: scheduled send-later capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of undo send.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window

citations.quote: Next to "Undo Send," select a Send cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds.
If you decide you don't want to send an email, you have a short time after to cancel it.
Right after you send a message, you can retract it: ... Click Undo.
